desc: Newspaper Advertisement of intimation to the members for 38th Annual General Meeting and for updation of e-mail address and Bank Account details - Reg

We hereby inform that Annual General Meeting of the shareholders will be held on Friday 26th Day of September 2026 at 12:15 P.M. through video conferencing at the registered office of the company situated at door no.181,"Vasantham", 4th Cross Street, New Fairlands, Salem-636016.
We herewith enclose the Annual report for the year ending 31/03/2026.
We hereby submit the book closure details.
We hereby enclose a copy of the Notice of the 46th Annual General Meeting along with the news paper advertisement to be published.
